Login.title: DataGuard
Login.subtitle: Data center audit operations
Login.heading: Sign in
Login.description: Use your operator account to continue.

Settings.title: Application Settings
Settings.description: Customize application branding and Telegram notification templates.

DeviceGroups.pageDescription: Group devices by responsible PIC so a whole group shares one owner. Devices bind to a group, PICs inherit from the group.
DeviceGroups.emptyDescription: Create a group, then bind devices to it.
DeviceGroups.deleteConfirm: Delete group "{name}"? Devices stay, membership is removed.
DeviceGroups.modalDescription: Bind devices to this group; owners inherit from it.

Incidents.title: Incidents
Incidents.description: Track and manage data center incidents

handoffV2.noActiveLinked: No active linked local Incidents in this sample
handoffV2.noActiveLinkedHint: This is not proof that the fleet is threat-free or remediated. Detection coverage and source completeness are not verified here.
handoffV2.hint: Explicit local handoff only. PIC group is routing responsibility, not the assignee. No notifications are sent and WatchGuard remains unchanged. An existing linked Incident is returned without changing its assignment.
handoffV2.error: Handoff unavailable. Check current site permissions, target, assignee/PIC and required migrations.
handoffV2.existingResult: Linked existing local Incident #{id} (this detection was already handed off)
handoffV2.boundary: This creates or links a DC Incident for the analyst workflow only. It does not change the endpoint, the provider, or any WatchGuard state.

threatV2.invalidRange: Use a score range from 0 to 10 with the minimum not greater than the maximum.
threatV2.windowHint: Last 30 days. Filters affect the table only; the summary above covers all stored detections in that window.
threatV2.historical: Observed under a previous account revision; host identity is not re-verified. Local handoff is disabled for this row.

operationsV2.activityDescription: Recorded local actions, evaluations, handoffs, simulations and read-sync requests.
operationsV2.approvalsDescription: Local approval-mode intentions and provider execution requests. Local decisions never authorize a provider write; enabled execution uses its own gated section below.
operationsV2.readOnly: This ledger is read-only. It does not send commands or change provider status.
operationsV2.activityHint: This ledger records local actions, evaluations, local handoffs, simulation samples and read-sync requests. It is not live provider task execution.
operationsV2.approvalsHint: Local approval-mode intentions and evaluations only; this is not an actionable live approval queue.
operationsV2.blocker: Provider execution is blocked by the read-only policy. Approval cannot unlock it; historical states do not prove provider execution.
operationsV2.summary: Page {page} · {total} local records · up to {limit} per page
operationsV2.empty: No local records in this view.

statuses.succeeded: Recorded success (not proof of provider execution)

historyV2.title: Saved simulation versions
historyV2.hint: Save app-local configuration and explicitly record a bounded simulation sample. Each save creates a new version. Nothing is activated: no Incident, notification, sync request or WatchGuard command is created. Missing evidence remains blocked.
historyV2.name: Version name
historyV2.error: The operation could not be completed. Check site access, input and required migrations.
historyV2.unavailable: History has not loaded or is unavailable.
historyV2.bounded: Showing up to {count} newest versions and recorded samples for this site.

fleetV2.healthDescription: A fleet-wide snapshot from the latest synchronized device data.
fleetV2.attentionDescription: Urgent protection issues first, with servers and critical devices prioritized.
fleetV2.attentionEmptyHint: No disabled, error, installation error, or unknown protection status was reported.
fleetV2.inventoryDescription: Search the full inventory and open a device to review its details.
fleetV2.connectivityNote: Protection and connectivity are separate: offline means no contact for more than three days, not proof that protection is disabled. Unknown contact is tracked separately.
fleetV2.name: Device name

syncV2.title: Read the latest device data
syncV2.hint: Queues inventory and protection reads for the background worker. No commands are sent to WatchGuard. Status checks stop after five minutes; refresh to check again.
syncV2.waiting: Waiting for the synchronization worker. A queued request does not mean the worker is online.
syncV2.already_pending: A read request is already pending.
syncV2.cooldown: Please wait until {time} before requesting another read.
syncV2.unavailable: Read sync is unavailable. Check site permissions, connection settings and required migrations.

states.running: Worker claimed the request; data is not updated yet.
states.partial: Read incomplete; not a successful refresh.
states.failed: Read failed; previous data may be out of date.
states.cancelled: Local request cancelled; previously started provider reads may still finish.

playbooksV2.completenessUnavailable: No current source-specific read evidence is available. Matching detections remain blocked until a complete, fresh read is recorded for the current account, credentials and settings. Endpoint syncs are not detection provenance.
playbooksV2.policyNote: Evidence helper, not provider severity or authorization. No proposed action executes.

tiers.7-8: 7–8: local Incident / PIC; future eligible workstation scan only
tiers.9-10: 9–10: local priority escalation; disruptive actions require approval
tiers.missing: Missing score: separate event-policy review, never zero

playbooksV2.title: Threat review
playbooksV2.description: Review stored evidence, record local outcomes, then explicitly hand off an Incident or request a local decision. WatchGuard remains read-only.
playbooksV2.advancedTitle: Advanced · templates, simulations and technical evidence
playbooksV2.advancedDescription: Admin-only preparation and inspection tools. These sections are not part of recording a threat review.
playbooksV2.simulationHint: Save reusable review versions and record bounded simulations only. A new valid version appears in the review selector after refreshing its choices.
playbooksV2.catalogHint: Inspect inert templates and stored sample results. Nothing here scans, isolates or remediates an endpoint.
playbooksV2.locked: Simulation only · WatchGuard READ-ONLY for this catalog
playbooksV2.safety: Previews record evidence only. Provider commands and notifications are suppressed by the capability contract; incidents and handoffs are real local work that requires an operator.
playbooksV2.severityNote: Local Incident severity is a suggested priority, not authorization to execute any action.
playbooksV2.coverage: Preview reads stored detections only. ThreatSync and event coverage depends on site ingestion. Matching detections with unknown identity or stale/incomplete evidence are blocked. The latest source read must be complete, fresh and bound to current settings; a successful endpoint sync does not establish detection completeness or platform support.
playbooksV2.filterNote: Category and source filter templates and sample rows. Score filters sample rows only; missing scores stay separate from 1–10.
playbooksV2.error: Preview unavailable. Check your active site access and try again.
playbooksV2.notLoaded: Select Preview to read the active site's stored data. No sample has been loaded.
playbooksV2.truncated: Truncated: more detections exist in this window. These are sample results, not full-site totals.
playbooksV2.bounded: Limited to this 24-hour window and sample cap; not full-site totals or a live provider query.
playbooksV2.empty: No stored sample rows match these filters. Check site ingestion or widen the filters.
playbooksV2.noTemplates: No templates match. Change category or source.
playbooksV2.healthUnavailable: Health and local templates are previewed from stored observations in the operational preview section below. This detection preview does not evaluate them.

reasons.eligible: Criteria met; all steps remain inert
reasons.criteria: Source, category or score does not match
reasons.unsupported: Unavailable template preview or unsupported source, category or score

playbooksV2.stepAvailable: real local work (evidence or operator action)

Epdr.readOnlyHint: Endpoint Security inventory and evidence are read-only. Provider writes, when an administrator enables them, use a separate second-admin approval pipeline.

setup.title: Connect WatchGuard for {site}
setup.body: Once connected, this page shows every protected device, what needs attention, and any threats found.
setup.steps: Enter account details|Test the connection|Turn it on
setup.askAdmin: Ask a superadmin to connect WatchGuard for this site.
setup.disabledBody: Data stops updating while the connection is paused.
setup.firstSyncTitle: Waiting for the first successful sync
setup.firstSyncBody: No completed device sync has been recorded yet. Activating the connection does not start the background worker. Ask your administrator to check the watchguard-worker service and its logs; this screen cannot confirm that it is running.
setup.refreshHint: Checks the saved status every 15 seconds for up to five minutes. This does not start a WatchGuard sync; refresh manually after that.
setup.emptyInventory: The device sync completed successfully, but returned no devices for this account.
setup.errorBody: The last sync failed or was incomplete. Ask your administrator to check the watchguard-worker logs and connection settings. Any data shown may be out of date.
setup.staleBody: The last successful sync was {time}. The numbers below may be out of date.

endpoints.title: Endpoint Security
endpoints.description: Protection status of every device WatchGuard manages at this site.
endpoints.needsAttention: {count, plural, one {# device needs attention} other {# devices need attention}}
endpoints.fleetMapHint: One square per device. Hover for the name, select to open details.
endpoints.mapSample: The map shows the first {count} endpoints by hostname; the table and totals cover the full current fleet.

bucketHint.outdated: Protected, but the engine or threat database is not up to date.
bucketHint.disabled: Someone or something switched protection off. This device is exposed.
bucketHint.error: Protection is installed but reports a fault. Usually fixed by repairing protection in WatchGuard Cloud.
bucketHint.install_error: The protection agent failed to install on this device.
bucketHint.no_license: No WatchGuard license is assigned to this device.
bucketHint.unknown: WatchGuard returned a status dc-check does not recognise yet.

nextStep.outdated: Wait for the next update cycle. If it persists, check the device's internet access.
nextStep.disabled: Turn protection back on in WatchGuard Cloud, or ask the device owner why it was disabled.
nextStep.error: In WatchGuard Cloud, open this device and run Repair protection. dc-check cannot do this automatically.
nextStep.install_error: Re-run the WatchGuard installer on this device, or check the install error in WatchGuard Cloud.
nextStep.no_license: Assign a license in WatchGuard Cloud, or remove the device if it is retired.
nextStep.unknown: Check this device in WatchGuard Cloud.

drawer.criticalHint: Critical devices always need approval before any action.
drawer.noAutoHint: Every future action on this device will wait for a person.
drawer.assetHint: Optional. Linking connects this device to its DataGuard asset record.
drawer.assetSearch: Search asset name, IP or code
drawer.readOnlyNote: Only site admins can change these settings.

threats.title: Threats
threats.description: Malware and suspicious activity WatchGuard found at this site.
threats.clearBody: Nothing that needs handling in the last 30 days.
threats.active: {count, plural, one {# threat needs handling} other {# threats need handling}}
threats.activeBody: Each one is tracked as an Incident. Open it to follow up.
threats.trendEmpty: No detections in the last 30 days.
threats.ignoredHint: Stored for review but not turned into incidents.

categoryHint.malware: Malicious software such as trojans or ransomware.
categoryHint.pup: Potentially unwanted programs, usually adware or bundled tools.
categoryHint.exploit: An attempt to abuse a software weakness.
categoryHint.ioa: Indicator of attack: behaviour that looks like an intrusion in progress.
categoryHint.other: A category WatchGuard reported that dc-check does not classify.

settings.title: WatchGuard connection
settings.description: Connect each site to its own WatchGuard account. dc-check only reads from WatchGuard.
settings.siteListHint: Pick a site to set up or change its connection.
settings.regionHint: Where your WatchGuard account is hosted.
settings.accountHint: Starts with WGC-. You can find it in WatchGuard Cloud.
settings.credentialsBody: These stay encrypted on the server and are never shown again.
settings.apiKeyHint: A shared key from WatchGuard Cloud.
settings.roHint: Used for everything right now, since dc-check only reads data.
settings.rwHint: Not used yet — saved for a future update. Keep it in the Advanced section.
settings.stored: Saved — enter a new value to change it
settings.testFail: Some checks failed — see the list.
settings.testHint: dc-check checks login, account, device data and threat data separately.
settings.activateTitle: Turn on & set how often to refresh
settings.syncHint: How often dc-check reads fresh data from WatchGuard.
settings.enableHint: Data only stays fresh while the connection is enabled.
settings.doneBody: WatchGuard data will now appear on the Endpoint Security and Threats pages.

global.title: Global safeguards
global.description: These apply to every site. They stay mostly untouched.
global.killSwitchHint: When on, dc-check will not change anything on WatchGuard. Reading still works.
global.allowedHint: The deployment ceiling. A site can only narrow it; every write still needs a second administrator's approval.
global.hourlyCapLabel: Max actions per site per hour
global.simMinDaysHint: How long a rule must run in simulation before automatic mode is allowed.

detection.title: Detection & safeguards
detection.description: What WatchGuard signals become incidents at this site, and how aggressively dc-check may act.
detection.eventsHint: Which findings become incidents. Malware, unwanted programs and exploits are the usual ones.
detection.scoreHint: Only ThreatSync incidents between these scores are turned into incidents.
detection.correlationHint: Findings for the same device and threat inside this window join one incident.
detection.reopenHint: A repeat of the same threat inside this window reopens the old incident.
detection.killSwitchHint: When on, no automated action runs at this site.
detection.retentionHint: Technical evidence of provider writes is cleaned up on a schedule. The request, its frozen snapshot and the approval record are kept permanently.
detection.retentionAttemptHint: Dispatch and observation attempt rows of finished requests are deleted after this window (7–3650).
detection.retentionResultHint: Provider receipts and responses are redacted after this window (7–3650, at least as long as attempt retention).
detection.breakerHint: Stops automation for the site if too much happens at once.
detection.healthHint: Track devices whose protection is disabled or failing.

localRunV2.title: Threat review
localRunV2.hint: Record a local review over one detection and an immutable saved version: evidence is stored, an analyst review is required, provider actions stay suppressed and notifications stay disabled. Showing choices never creates anything.
localRunV2.selectorNote: These choices identify stored evidence only; they do not establish eligibility or authorize execution. The saved review records the final policy and its reasons.
localRunV2.noVersions: No usable saved review version is available. Author one below, then refresh these choices.
localRunV2.noDetections: No current threat is available for this account. Return to Threats when new evidence has been stored.
localRunV2.requestedUnavailable: The linked threat is not current for this account or is no longer available. Return to Threats and select an active detection.
localRunV2.detectionsLimited: The selector shows the 100 most recent threats. A valid linked threat is still included when outside this window.
localRunV2.confirm: I confirm this creates a local review only. Recording its steps will not scan or isolate a device, send a notification, or create an Incident.

errors.invalid_input: Choose a valid threat and review version, confirm local-only review, then try again.
errors.binding_unavailable: Local review is not ready. Check active-site access and WatchGuard read configuration in Settings; this does not change the read-only lock.
errors.version_unavailable: That saved review version is unavailable or no longer valid. Refresh choices and select another version.
errors.detection_unavailable: That threat is unavailable or belongs to older account evidence. Return to Threats and select a current detection.
errors.service_unavailable: The local review service is temporarily unavailable. Check site access and try again; no provider action was requested.
errors.version_definition_changed: The catalog template changed since this version was saved. Author a new version; the old one is never reinterpreted.
errors.detection_outside_configuration: This detection is outside the version's saved filters. Nothing was created; pick another version or detection.
errors.detection_outside_template: This detection does not match the template criteria. Nothing was created.

localRunV2.empty: No local reviews yet. Select a threat and a saved version above to begin.
localRunV2.finishedNote: Suppressed and operator-required steps are final local evidence; they are never replayed as provider work.
localRunV2.started: Local review #{id} created. It is pending; use Record review steps to record its local outcomes.
localRunV2.existing: The existing local review #{id} was opened. Inspect its saved status before recording any steps.
localRunV2.resume_finished: Pending local steps were recorded. This does not mean the threat was removed or remediated.
localRunV2.resume_busy_or_finished: This review is already finished or claimed by another recording pass. Refresh and inspect its saved status.
localRunV2.resume_fenced: The review lease or account revision changed; reload before retrying. No provider action was requested.

statusHint.pending: Evidence and steps are saved, but their local outcomes have not been recorded. Use Record review steps when ready.
statusHint.running: An explicit recording pass is claimed by an operator. There is no background worker; wait for that pass or inspect again later.
statusHint.finished: All local outcomes are saved. This does not establish threat removal, remediation or Incident completion; operator-required follow-up remains manual.

policy.blocked: Blocked from a local action proposal

localRunV2.policyNote: This is the recommendation captured with the review, not permission to execute. Notifications and WatchGuard execution remain disabled.

reasons.unsupported: The source, category, score or requested route is unsupported.
reasons.identity: Endpoint identity is unknown, incomplete or removed.
reasons.partial: Required source-read evidence is incomplete or unknown.
reasons.stale: Required evidence is stale, missing or has an invalid timestamp.
reasons.hold: A linked Incident has an automation hold.
reasons.unknown_flags: Endpoint policy flags are unknown; eligibility cannot be inferred.
reasons.eligible: Evidence supports a recommendation only; provider execution remains blocked.

localRunV2.technicalEvidence: Advanced · raw step ledger and immutable evidence
localRunV2.nextActionsHint: Creating or linking an Incident is a separate action. It may place an automation hold, but it does not scan, isolate or notify.
localRunV2.approvalHint: This saved review proposes a provider-action intention. Request a local decision only; a different admin records it and no command is ever sent.
localRunV2.approvalRequested: Local approval request #{id} created. Open Local decisions for a different admin's decision; no endpoint action was performed.
localRunV2.capabilityNotice: Capability contract: provider actions are {provider} and notifications are {notification} in a local review. Recording evidence, analyst review, local decisions and the incident handoff are real work.
localRunV2.incompatibleNote: {count} saved version(s) cannot be used right now:
localRunV2.versionsLimited: Only the 100 most recent versions are listed.
localRunV2.authoringHint: No usable version exists yet. Save one below (simulation filters only); it appears in the selector after the choices refresh and is selected automatically.
localRunV2.versionSaved: Version saved: #{id} v{version}. It is selected for the next review.

eligibility.title: Pre-create eligibility (read-only, nothing is created by showing this)
eligibility.ok: This detection and version currently pass every local gate. Creating the review still requires your explicit confirmation below.

blocker.version_unavailable: The selected version no longer exists on this site.
blocker.detection_unavailable: The selected detection is no longer available for this connection and revision.
blocker.version_definition_changed: The catalog template changed since this version was saved. Author a new version instead; old ones are never reinterpreted.
blocker.detection_outside_configuration: This detection is outside the version's saved filters. Pick another version or another detection.
blocker.detection_outside_template: This detection does not match the template's criteria. Nothing would be recorded; pick a matching detection.

outcomeReasons.explicit_admin_review_requested_not_reso: An explicit administrator review was recorded; it does not claim any resolution.
outcomeReasons.use_explicit_local_incident_handoff: Requires the explicit local incident handoff below; nothing was created automatically.
outcomeReasons.notifications_disabled: Suppressed: local notification delivery is disabled in this surface.
outcomeReasons.provider_execution_disabled: Suppressed: provider execution is disabled in this surface; nothing was sent.

notifyV2.title: Local notifications
notifyV2.hint: In-app notifications for the current assignee of explicitly handed-off EPDR Incidents. No email, Telegram or webhook is sent. Delivery stays inside DataGuard and is rechecked at delivery time.
notifyV2.enabled: Enable local in-app notifications for this site
notifyV2.notifyHeld: Also notify incidents under automation hold
notifyV2.scope: Recipient scope: the current assignee only. PIC groups remain routing responsibility and are not converted into recipients automatically.
notifyV2.error: Notification settings unavailable. Check site access and required migrations.

kind.sla_escalation: Incident #{id} passed its SLA and was escalated to site admins
kind.digest: Local digest ready · {assigned} assigned · {overdue} overdue · {incidents} Incidents

notifyV2.quietHint: Local inbox delivery pauses during this UTC window. End hour is exclusive; windows can cross midnight.
notifyV2.quietInvalid: Choose different start and end hours.
notifyV2.digest: Unread digest: {assigned} assigned · {overdue} overdue across {incidents} Incidents. Computed from the inbox on read; no scheduled delivery exists.
notifyV2.escalateOverdue: Escalate overdue Incidents to site admins
notifyV2.escalateHint: An additional in-app notice for active site admins. The assignee still receives the overdue notice; this never changes the Incident or provider status.
notifyV2.digestHint: One summary per recipient per UTC day, at or after the chosen hour. The digest only summarizes unread notices and respects the quiet window.

operationalV2.title: Stored operational preview
operationalV2.observationOnly: Healthy observation is not remediation/closure; no writes/provider calls.
operationalV2.truncated: Combined sample capped at 100, not exhaustive.
operationalV2.empty: No stored operational evidence to sample.

approvalsV2.title: Local approvals
approvalsV2.hint: Local approval requests for provider-action intentions from a playbook review. Approval is recorded as a local decision and never sends a command.
approvalsV2.readOnly: Approving here records a local decision only. Provider execution uses a separate, gated request pipeline.
approvalsV2.decisionOnly: Approvals only record local admin decisions. They never scan or isolate endpoints.
approvalsV2.error: Local approvals are unavailable. Check site access and migrations.
approvalsV2.approvedNote: Approval recorded locally. This note is a decision record; provider execution still requires its own gated request, approval and dispatch pipeline.
approvalsV2.rejectedNote: Rejected locally. No provider action was sent.

feedback.approved: Local approval recorded; no provider command was sent.

execution.title: Provider execution
execution.hint: Request a single provider operation on one endpoint, have it approved by a different administrator, then let the worker send it. A request never contacts WatchGuard on its own.
execution.enabled: Provider writes are enabled for this site.
execution.disabled: Provider writes are disabled. Nothing can be sent until both the deployment and this site enable them.

reasons.global_writes_disabled: The deployment-wide write gate is off.
reasons.site_writes_disabled: This site's write gate is off.
reasons.global_kill_switch: The global kill switch is active.
reasons.site_kill_switch: This site's kill switch is active.
reasons.automation_paused: Automation is paused for this site.
reasons.write_credentials_missing: No read-write credential is stored for this connection.

execution.approvalWindow: An approval is valid for {minutes} minutes and only for the exact target and parameters it was given.
execution.effectiveLimits: Effective limits: at most {cap} writes per hour, at least {minutes} minutes between writes to the same endpoint and action.

errors.invalid_input: The request is not valid. Check the endpoint, the action and its parameters.
errors.action_not_allowed: That action is not allowed for this deployment or site.
errors.credentials_missing: No read-write credential is stored for this connection.
errors.endpoint_unavailable: The endpoint is unavailable or outside this site.
errors.target_unresolved: The provider target could not be resolved for this endpoint.
errors.blocked: The request is blocked by a safety rule.
errors.duplicate_active_request: An identical request is already active.
errors.service_unavailable: Provider execution is unavailable. Check access and migrations.

settings.title: Write enablement
settings.hint: Both gates must be on. Site actions narrow the deployment ceiling; an empty list allows nothing.
settings.globalToggle: Enable provider writes for the whole deployment (superadmin).
settings.siteToggle: Enable provider writes for this site.
settings.siteCap: Hourly write cap for this site (empty = follow the deployment cap)
settings.cooldown: Cooldown between writes to the same endpoint and action (minutes)
settings.confirm: I understand these actions change endpoint state on the provider.

execution.impactHigh: This action changes endpoint isolation or continuity state. Only isolation has an in-app release action; reboot, process termination and quarantine do not.
execution.impactStandard: This action changes provider state and is recorded as an execution request.
execution.confirmRequest: I understand this records a request that another administrator must approve before anything is sent.
execution.noSendNote: Creating a request sends nothing. The worker can only send it after a different administrator approves the exact target and parameters.

stateHint.pending_approval: Waiting for a different site administrator. Nothing has been sent.
stateHint.queued: Approved and waiting for the worker to send it.
stateHint.dispatching: The worker is sending this request now.
stateHint.in_progress: The provider accepted the request. Completion is not yet confirmed.
stateHint.completed: The provider reported the operation performed. This does not prove the endpoint is clean or the threat resolved.
stateHint.failed: The provider rejected the request or it failed before completion. Review the attempt evidence.
stateHint.outcome_unknown: The request may or may not have reached the provider. It will not be re-sent; observation resolves it.
stateHint.needs_review: The request cannot be resolved automatically. Review the evidence before creating a new one.

execution.approveHint: Check the target, parameters and revisions above. Approval authorizes exactly this snapshot; any change invalidates it.
execution.approveConfirm: I approve this exact target and these exact parameters.
execution.resolveHint: This request could not be resolved automatically. Closing it records your review and allows a new request later; it makes no claim about what the provider did.
execution.observationAutomatic: Completion can be read back from the provider.
execution.observationManual: Only acceptance can be confirmed. Completion requires manual review and is never inferred.
execution.outcomeUnknown: Outcome unknown ({reason}). Do not re-send; wait for observation or review the provider state directly.
execution.requested: Execution request #{id} created. Nothing has been sent.
execution.approved: Request #{id} approved and queued. The worker sends it after re-checking every gate.

providerTargets.title: ThreatSync targets
providerTargets.hint: Incidents ingested from the provider wait for your confirmation. Confirm which endpoint each entity belongs to; an unconfirmed target can never be used for an action. Confirming never contacts the provider.
providerTargets.confirmed: Target confirmed. ThreatSync actions may now be requested for this endpoint.
providerTargets.rejected: Target rejected. It stays on record but can never authorize an action.

errors.endpoint_unavailable: The selected endpoint is unavailable or outside this connection.
errors.service_unavailable: Provider targets are unavailable. Check access and migrations.

mislink.title: Historical endpoint links to review ({count})
mislink.hint: These detections kept an endpoint under a linking rule that compared ThreatSync entity ids with device ids. History is not rewritten; confirm the correct target above or reject it.

executionHealth.title: Execution health
executionHealth.hint: Live counters for the provider-write pipeline and the oldest requests that have not reached a terminal state yet.
executionHealth.unavailable: Execution health is unavailable. Check access and migrations.
